channel.title: Humanoid News
channel.description: Independent, answer-first news on humanoid robots: Tesla Optimus, Figure, Agility, Boston Dynamics, Unitree, 1X and more.

item.title: Tesla pushes external Optimus deliveries to late 2027
item.description: Tesla now targets the end of 2027 for delivering Optimus humanoids to outside customers, citing unsolved problems with the hands, durability and AI.

item.title: Danish grocer Føtex pilots Unitree humanoids for overnight restocking
item.description: Salling Group's Føtex chain is trialling humanoid robots built on Unitree hardware and HIVE Robots software to restock shelves after closing.

item.title: NVIDIA expands Isaac platform with Agile ONE SN reference humanoid
item.description: NVIDIA announced new Isaac frameworks, simulation pipelines and data, plus a humanoid reference platform from Agile Robots built on Isaac GR00T.

item.title: South Korea eases safety rules to put 20 humanoids on factory floors
item.description: Korean regulators relaxed rules written for stationary industrial robots, clearing the way for 20 Robros humanoids to work in factories.

item.title: Minerva Humanoids raises $10M to build robots for dangerous jobs
item.description: San Francisco start-up Minerva Humanoids emerged from stealth with about $10 million led by General Catalyst for its semi-autonomous humanoid, Roger.
